associations.rationale: The theorem says that every A-linear endomorphism of the simple module is scalar. This is the Schur-lemma input used in the source argument, but it does not say that each action operator is such an endomorphism or that every subspace is A-stable.

The theorem concludes that the simple module has finrank one. That is a consequence of the source argument and can imply the limited form of its subspace conclusion, but it does not state that scalar action makes every subspace a subrepresentation.
